posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Keep in mind though in a situation where you are only using these three heroes, that it may be in the best interest to use Gung-Ho to allow Young Legacy to use a power out of turn rather than Finest Legacy. For the simple fact that Young Legacy using a power would deal out 4 energy damage with just the 1 galvanize on Greatest turn, then will deal out another 4 on her own power phase, making a total of 8. While using it to activate galvanize would only allow her to deal 5 on her turn. Even if you throw in Young Legacy playing a damaging card like Thokk, the damages would still be 12 or 10.

 

Granted with more than 3 heroes then that changes, such as a team of 5 heroes, where there will be 3 heroes doing tons of damage then it would be worth having Legacy galvanize!
